notes:
- Faster Open, Save As and Project Xfer on big projects.
- Scene user/comment/range are now read once per file and remembered (even after restarting Maya); a file is only re-read when it changes.
- Folder listings are cached until a folder changes. The Refresh buttons force a full rescan.
- After Maya starts or you switch projects, TP_pipe indexes the project's scene files in the background (see the Script Editor for "scene index ready").
